ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor for direct links to this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. Main heading displayed above the cards. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Briefly introduce this group of cards. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Practical, dependable services designed around your goals.

BentoCards.helper: Add as many cards as needed. Only the first four are displayed. Card 1 displays its image, and Card 4 displays up to four value propositions.

CardTitle.helper: Optional. Add a short, clear card heading. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.

CardDescription.helper: Optional. Explain this item in one or two concise sentences. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.
CardDescription.placeholder: Build a clear plan that connects your website to your business goals.

CardIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

CardIconColor.helper: Choose the icon color from the available options.

Image.helper: Required. Uploads go to Content/. Use a landscape image at least 1200 by 675 pixels. Only Card 1 displays its image in this layout.

ImageAltText.helper: Optional but IMPORTANT for meaningful images. Describe what the image communicates for people using assistive technology. Leave blank only when the image is decorative.
ImageAltText.placeholder: Two people reviewing a website plan together

LearnMoreText.helper: Optional. Text displayed for the card link. When a web addresses is present and this is blank, Learn more is used. If the card title is blank, use descriptive link text for accessibility.

LearnMoreUrl.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https web addresses. When valid, the entire card becomes clickable.

ValuePropositions.helper: Optional. Add short supporting points. Only Card 4 displays these values, and only its first four entries are rendered.

items.helper: Enter the items to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Add a short note below the cards. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: Choose a service to learn more.
